title: One icon for resources, one for influence, everywhere
description: Every place the web UI showed resources or influence as text (Res / Inf, 3R/1I, '4 Resources', '2 influence', '3 v') now uses the two shared icons with the number. Screen readers and tooltips still get the full word (aria-label and title: '1 resource', '6 influence', '2 of 5 resources'). Synthetic fixtures, not captured engine states. The production builder budget and Leadership payment are the versions that exist on this branch.

notes.title: Text equivalent
notes.text: Every icon sits in an element with role=img, aria-label and title carrying the full word with the right plural ('1 resource', '0 resources', '6 influence', '2 of 5 resources'). The number is visible; the word is not.

notes.title: Left as words
notes.text: Sentences from the engine or content (card rules text, event-log lines, prompts and option labels), and short sentences where the word carries the meaning ('Spend influence to vote'). The full list is docs/ICON_USAGE.md.

notes.title: Colours
notes.text: Gold diamond (resources) and blue crown (influence) come from --value-resource / --value-influence tokens; a dimmed variant marks spent or zero values. The app has no light theme, so only the dark values are shown.
